name: canary
description: The app-health / errors / uptime / observability employee — the early warning that's actually actionable: instrument once on OpenTelemetry, page on symptoms, scaffold MWMBR SLO burn-rate alerts, audit the version-specific footguns, and prove the page actually delivers. App health only — LLM token spend is agentmoney's. Powered by Energy.
author: Energy Platform
install_instructions:
1. Install deps and build: pnpm install && pnpm build
2. Add this plugin to Claude Code: Settings → Plugins → Add local plugin → select this directory.
3. The canary CLI, the canary MCP server (instrument_service / scaffold_slo / audit_observability / check_delivery / detect_cardinality / explain_pitfall / search_brain), the 5 skills, the footgun-gate hook, and the observability-auditor + alerting-reviewer sub-agents are now available.
